page_purpose: Present The Week-by-Week Yearline as a complete RetroVerse 1978 timeline page page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `year_timeline`.
page_intent_readback: Present The Week-by-Week Yearline as a complete RetroVerse 1978 timeline page page, with page-aware artwork under real typography and no text baked into the illustration layer for `year_timeline`.
composition_type: information-forward full-page background with modular overlay zones

art_zone_dimensions.purpose: Background illustration layer beneath final layout typography.

color_palette: cream paper base with black ink, muted cyan, and mustard accents
scene_description: A restrained timeline-support background for 1978, with archival texture and movement cues but no embedded labels.
visual_hierarchy: Primary focal area supports The Week-by-Week Yearline.
Secondary props reinforce `year_timeline` without competing with text zones.
Negative space stays calm inside title, body, sidebar, and footer zones.
Background shapes should guide the eye without competing with charts, stat boxes, or data overlays.
optional_easter_egg_guidance: Optional and subtle only: a tiny RetroVerse Easter egg may appear as environmental detail, but it must never behave like final page typography.
studio_role_responsibility: Build restrained background structures for chart, stat, snapshot, and timeline pages without replacing the real data overlay.
studio_style_rules: Support numeric storytelling with graphic rhythm, framing, and icon-level cues rather than finished charts.
Keep backgrounds quieter and more modular than feature-scene artwork.
Never render legible data labels, axes, tables, or ranking text into the art layer.
text_rendering_instruction: DO NOT RENDER FINAL TEXT INTO THE ARTWORK
